rows.grounds: compound object identified with supreme Brahman
vocative address to the disciple or goddess

items.question: How does reciting and depositing the seed-nectar establish identity with the supreme absolute reality?
premises: The seed-nectar is equated with the supreme absolute reality.
The practitioner deposits the seed-nectar through ritual action.
items.inference: Reciting and depositing the seed-nectar enacts realization of the supreme absolute reality.
uncertainties: The precise locus or manner of depositing (nikṣipya) is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O beautiful one, by reciting the seed-nectar, which is the supreme absolute reality, and by depositing it, one accomplishes that realization.
